method: For sample rate Fs in hertz and an N-point FFT, the sample period is 1/Fs, subcarrier spacing is Fs/N and the useful symbol duration is N/Fs. The cyclic prefix is the selected exact fraction of N samples and must resolve to a whole sample. Total symbol duration is (N + Ncp)/Fs, symbol rate is Fs/(N + Ncp), occupied bandwidth is the active-subcarrier count times Fs/N, and prefix overhead is Ncp/(N + Ncp). The occupied-bandwidth value is a nominal occupied-subcarrier span; guard bands, windowing, spectral masks and standard-specific fractional prefixes are not modelled.
